# 0x22A — `brake_switch_candidate`

DLC 2 · 10 Hz · status: **hypothesis**

Two bytes, normally 00 00. One bit follows the rear brake pedal.

## Layout

Bytes are numbered from 0. Multi-byte values are big-endian unless a row says otherwise. Bit 7 is the most significant bit of a byte.

| Byte | Content |
|---|---|
| B0 | — |
| B1 | `brake_switch` |

## Signals

| Signal | Where | Type | Value | Unit | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `brake_switch` | B1 bit 3 | flag | raw |  | hypothesis (medium) |
| `b1_motion_flag` | B1 bits 7..4 | 4-bit field | raw |  | ruled out |

### `brake_switch`

B1 = 0x08 while the rear brake pedal switch (0x268 B4 bit 2) is on: 2209 of 2217 such frames on one ride, 99.2 % on another. Whether the front lever also sets it (which would make it a brake-light signal) is not tested.

### `b1_motion_flag`

An early reading of B1 = 0x50 as "moving" did not hold: B1 stays 0x00 at a sustained 100 km/h.
